subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR be rebased as a separate composer token meter, folded into the current context-usage instrument, or retired because current main now covers the central context-progress UX?
rationale: Current main has a newer chat composer architecture and a richer context-usage display, while the PR still adds a parallel raw-token meter to the legacy view path.

options.title: Fold Into Current Context Usage
options.body: Port only the desired meter affordance into `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts` and reuse the freshness-aware context model.

options.title: Retire The PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if the existing current-main context-usage instrument is the intended UX.

options.title: Keep A Separate Meter
options.body: Require a rebase plus stale-token styling or hiding semantics so the new meter does not conflict with the existing context display.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Current Context Usage
recommendation.body: Port only the desired meter affordance into `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts` and reuse the freshness-aware context model.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main chat composer and freshness-contract history makes steipete the best routing candidate for the architecture/product choice.
